preconditions.description: The first line contains exactly two integers n and d, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 0 ≤ d ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**15 for x in stdin.split()[2:]) and len(stdin.split()[2:]) == int(stdin.split()[0])
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers h1, h2, ..., hn, where 1 ≤ hi ≤ 10^15.
The input consists of exactly two lines separated by a newline.

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines separated by a newline.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for x in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The second line of the output contains k integers i1, i2, ..., ik, where 1 ≤ i1 < i2 < ... < ik ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: k == int(stdout.split()[0]) and k >= 1 and k <= int(stdin.split()[0])
postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains an integer k, the maximal length of a jump sequence, where 1 ≤ k ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(int(stdin.split()[2 + (int(x) - 1)]) - int(stdin.split()[2 + (int(y) - 1)])) >= int(stdin.split()[1]) for x, y in zip(stdout.split()[1:], stdout.split()[2:]))
postconditions.description: For every consecutive pair of pillars (i_j, i_{j+1}) in the sequence, the absolute height difference |h_{i_j} - h_{i_{j+1}}| ≥ d.

postconditions.expression: not any(len(sequence) > k for sequence in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in open('__temp_output__', 'r') if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The output sequence is of maximal possible length k (no longer sequence exists for the given input).
